description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

uses.name: Myr Welder
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with two charge counters on it
